verdict.rationale: Automatic image captioning is a fair extraction-quality question for a web scraping and data-extraction platform like Apify, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions generating captions or alt-text descriptions for page images. The marketplace size and the general scraping and Actor docs do not show this specific capability.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can get automatic captions for images on a page so a text-only model can reason about visual content
